handback.title: The board works on personal accounts too
handback.summary: The board works with a personal account's project, not only an organization's.

raises.label: Doubt: app access
raises.text: GitHub may refuse the app access to a personal account's board. Build it as asked anyway? The plan assumes yes.
raises.evidence: `.github/workflows/board.yml` uses the app token; `dokima/manifest.py` grants only `organization_projects`.

handback.feature: Personal account boards work like organization boards: the board code reads them, then the install guide says so.

stories.title: Board code reads a personal account's project
stories.user_story: Owners on a personal account get card moves and a passing board audit, as organizations do.
stories.context: `dokima/board.py` and `dokima/audit.py` read the board only under `organization(login:)`, and `add_view` posts to `orgs/`. Every other caller (`scan.py`, `card.py`, `agent_roles.py`) goes through `board.Board`. PR #945 holds a working build: a `parse` of `org/number` or `user:login/number` and one `project()` reader both modules share; reuse it.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the board setting names a personal account's project, every board read finds that project.
acceptance_criteria.words: `DOKIMA_BOARD` names either an organization's project or a user's project (for example `user:<login>/<number>`, or found by owner type), and every board query reads it either way.

edge_cases.case: A board setting naming neither an organization nor a user is refused with an error naming it.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a board view is missing, it is created on the project's own owner, organization or personal account.
acceptance_criteria.words: every board query reads it either way
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One call to one place; the bad setting case is covered under the first criterion.

acceptance_criteria.text: The audit checks the board fields Status, Action and Priority the same way on both kinds of board.
acceptance_criteria.words: The board fields (Status, Action, Priority) are checked the same way on both.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A missing board already fails the audit with its reason today; nothing new to cover.

stories.title: Install guide stops saying personal repos skip the board
stories.user_story: Owners on a personal account read in the install guide that the board works for them.
stories.context: `docs/wiki/Installing.md` Requirements says the board needs an organization and is skipped on personal repos; its `DOKIMA_BOARD` row names only `org/number`. The README on main no longer says either.

acceptance_criteria.text: The install guide no longer says personal repos skip the board.
acceptance_criteria.words: The install docs stop saying personal repos skip the board.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A fixed page of text; there is no input to vary.
